title: Parse Error in duplicated .tscn with attached script when preloaded as static var
body: ### Tested versions 4.5.stable ### System information Godot v4.5.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7703) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10750H CPU @ 2.60GHz (12 threads) - 15.84 GiB memory ### Issue description After duplicating one of my scene, I get the error: ``` ERROR: scene/resources/resource_format_text.cpp:279 - Parse Error: Busy. [Resource file res://player/JaneSpaceSkin/JaneSpaceSkin.tscn:178] ERROR: Failed loading resource: res://player/JaneSpaceSkin/JaneSpaceSkin.tscn. ERROR: scene/resources/resource_format_text.cpp:279 - Parse Error: Busy. [Resource file res://player/JaneSpaceSkin/JaneSpaceSkin.tscn:178] ERROR: Failed loading resource: res://player/JaneSpaceSkin/JaneSpaceSkin.tscn. ``` While there is no obvious error at line 178: Attached is the full file (JaneSpaceSkin.tscn). [JaneSpaceSkin.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22571830/JaneSpaceSkin.zip) Note that after this failed import: - I am able to open the file in the editor and it behaves normally - I am unable to use it in-game, as it does not instantiate as a PlayerSkin ### Steps to reproduce I basically dupicated the .tscn of a PlayerSkin and tried to load either the original or the dupicated version as a PackedScene in my PlayerEntity. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) I failed to replicated it in this MRP, where: - I duplicated the cubeSkin.tscn and name it sphereSkin.tscn - I even edited the sphereSkin.tscn in VS Code to change the .glb path and uid - I reloaded the project - And no error! [replicate-inherited-script-cyclic.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22572299/replicate-inherited-script-cyclic.zip)
